name: Knights and soldiers
description: Knights and Soldiers in white, red and black: first strike, equipment, anthems and plenty of Soldier tokens.

cards.name: Dame Kerrowyn of the Burning Lance
cards.rule_text:
First strike
Equip abilities you activate cost {1} less to activate.
Whenever one or more equipped creatures you control attack, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
cards.flavor_text: "Ride with me, and bring every blade you own."

cards.name: Brisca Grimwarden, Iron Muster
cards.rule_text:
Vigilance
At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
Whenever another Knight or Soldier you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Lord-Marshal of the Twin Keeps
cards.rule_text:
First strike
Other Knights and Soldiers you control get +1/+1.
cards.flavor_text: Two castles, one banner, no retreat.

cards.name: Squire of the Ashen Road
cards.rule_text: As long as CARDNAME is equipped, it has first strike.
cards.flavor_text: He polishes another's armour today and dreams of his own.

cards.name: Gloomhelm Errant
cards.rule_text:
Menace
When CARDNAME dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Muster-Horn Recruiter
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
cards.flavor_text: One blast of the horn, and the whole village marches.

cards.name: Ironcinder Lancer
cards.rule_text:
First strike
Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if it's equipped, it gets +2/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Rampart Sergeant
cards.rule_text:
When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
Soldier tokens you control have vigilance.

cards.name: Blackforge Reaver
cards.rule_text:
First strike, menace
When CARDNAME enters, attach up to one target Equipment you control to it.
cards.flavor_text: Its blade was forged in a fire that never goes out.

cards.name: Dawnmarch Cavalier
cards.rule_text:
Vigilance
Whenever CARDNAME attacks, other attacking Knights and Soldiers you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Headsman of the Hollow Keep
cards.rule_text:
Menace
When CARDNAME enters, each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice.

cards.name: Warhorn Battlemaster
cards.rule_text:
Haste
When CARDNAME enters, create two 1/1 red Soldier creature tokens with haste.

cards.name: High Paladin of the Seventh Gate
cards.rule_text:
First strike, vigilance, lifelink
Other Knights and Soldiers you control have first strike.

cards.name: Sound the Iron Horn
cards.rule_text: Create two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens. Creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Volley of the Hundred Spears
cards.rule_text: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker, where X is the number of Knights and Soldiers you control.

cards.name: Sever the Oath
cards.rule_text: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. If you control an equipped creature, it gets -4/-4 until end of turn instead.
cards.flavor_text: A broken promise cuts deeper than any sword.

cards.name: Unbroken Shieldwall
cards.rule_text: Knights and Soldiers you control gain first strike and indestructible until end of turn.

cards.name: Pledged Greatblade
Standard of the Iron Pact
cards.rule_text:
Knights and Soldiers you control get +1/+1.
At the beginning of your end step, if you attacked with three or more creatures this turn, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
cards.flavor_text: Where it flies, no line breaks.
